title: Root Word Study
summary: Twenty weeks of Greek and Latin roots for grades 9–12: a pretest game, a sentence a day, flashcards, and a final quiz that scores itself.

steps.caption: The student view. One list of roots each week.
Each week starts with a quick pretest. It isn’t graded.
A matching game: pick a root, then its meaning.
Then a sentence for every root, flashcards, and a 12-question final quiz that scores itself.
The teacher dashboard. Choose which weeks students see and when the quiz opens.
The gradebook fills in on its own. Push quiz scores to Canvas in one click.
